figure sequence, evidence language and concept-boundary labels

boundary: The index records drawing-package readability and correspondence only.
It does not turn concept geometry, routes, nodes, facilities, accessibility, operations, permissions, land rights or funding into verified conditions.
It does not replace the required future human bilingual comparison after any substantive change.
